searchText: hi guys, I'm doing sharding (EIP 4844) research atm at university. Just wondering if the hardware requirement of doing local development and testing of ethereum is the same as running a full node? No, not even close. A private dev/test network has quite low operating requirements. Any computer/mobile device will probably be sufficient for a private dev/test network. Unless your plan is to do load/stress testing. Thanks In case you haven't seen these: notes on setting up a local EIP4844 devnet: https://hackmd.io/q1SLCaubTIWw_1zsEjW_Vg?view Devnet3 user guide: https://hackmd.io/@inphi/Hk_cLBJFo
